claims.claim: Born 17 September 1996 in Évreux, Normandy; nationality France
Won 2021 Hungarian Grand Prix for Alpine on 1 August 2021; first F1 win; first victory for the Alpine brand; 'shock maiden winner'
claims.note: Official site dates the win August 1, 2021 and says first victory for the Alpine brand. F1 says 'a shock maiden winner'.

claims.claim: Held off Sebastian Vettel in the Aston Martin; first-lap crashes and red flag; Alonso stall may have helped team mate
One race win, four podiums, 490 points from 198 Grands Prix
claims.note: F1 profile: podiums 4, points 490, entered 198; highest finish 1 (x1).

claims.claim: Route: Manor from 2016 Belgian GP, Force India, Mercedes reserve, Renault, Alpine, Haas
claims.note: F1 biography lists the teams in this order.

claims.claim: Five seasons with Renault and Alpine before Haas; joined Haas for 2025 partnering Ollie Bearman
Haas held a 2027 option and did not activate it; Komatsu said after summer break he was unlikely to be kept; 'not a definitive you're out'
Bearman outscored Ocon over the two seasons; Haas criticism of defensiveness, combativeness and 'blind-alley set-up work'
claims.note: Wording matches the fetched text, with the 'backs against the wall' quote kept verbatim.

claims.claim: Ocon was 'definitely a free agent for next year'; asked about staying he said 'Let's see'
Haas confirmed Ocon leaves at season end; Rafael Camara signed as replacement
claims.note: Sky: Haas confirmed Ocon will leave at the end of the season; Camara signed to replace him.

claims.claim: 'We're all on the same page', 'We know it's been an ongoing issue', 'It's reassuring that I'm doing a good job'
Rafael Camara is Ferrari-backed; favourite to replace Ocon; impressed by 'immense one-lap pace' at Portimao
claims.note: The Race describes him as Ferrari-backed and the replacement favourite.

claims.claim: Komatsu: 'affiliations or the packages they've got matters'
Bearman: drivers find the car 'really challenging'
Ocon repeatedly criticised the car, especially the brakes, during 2025
Radio 'don't do this to me' to Laura Mueller; soft tyres flat-spotted by Bearman, switched to mediums
Hirakawa 15th in Friday FP1; debut in qualifying and race partnering Bearman; 71-lap race
Komatsu: could not say much, but Ocon was not ill
Croft: 'the relationship between Esteban and the team hasn't been magnificent in recent races'; Chadwick: 'fighting for a drive'
Ryo Hirakawa took Ocon's seat for the rest of the Mexico City weekend (summary and body)
claims.note: Sky: Haas replaced Ocon with Hirakawa for the rest of the weekend.

claims.claim: FAQ: Haas confirmed Ocon leaves at season end and signed Camara as replacement

summary: All claims now match the fetched sources. Corrections made: removed the unnamed-sources attribution, the Camara F2 title and protege status, the reserve-driver description, the unsupported Ferrari-decisive sentence, the 'talking to other teams' clause, and the dates not in the sources.
